selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-change topology and initial (direct) internet access baseline for node2/node3
selected_evidence.summary: ip addr/route on all nodes showed a single flat /24 with platform gateway .1; ping/curl confirmed node2 and node3 already had direct internet access before any NAT change.

selected_evidence.requirement: NAT masquerade rule configured and committed on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed forwarding enabled, then set/committed/saved VyOS NAT source rule 100 (10.100.224.0/24 -> masquerade via eth0); verified via CLI show and via nft ruleset listing the masquerade rule.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2/node3 routed through node1 as the actual egress path
selected_evidence.summary: Default routes on node2 and node3 changed to next-hop 10.100.224.10 (node1), first at runtime then persisted via nmcli static route with lower metric than DHCP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Falsification: NAT dependency proven, redirect bypass found and closed
selected_evidence.summary: Disabling ICMP redirects (node1 send, node2/3 accept) stopped node2 from silently bypassing node1 via a platform redirect; NAT rule was then disabled and re-enabled via VyOS config to test/restore behavior.

selected_evidence.requirement: Direct proof NAT translation is actually occurring for node2/node3 traffic through node1
selected_evidence.summary: conntrack -L on node1 showed reply-side src rewritten to 10.100.224.10 for flows originated by 10.100.224.11/.12; nft masquerade rule counters incremented from 0 to nonzero packets/bytes.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered NAT state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 9028a473...; issued 'reboot now'; polled through connection-refused/timeout states; confirmed new boot_id 213c559d...; verified NAT rule persisted (show nat source rules) and conntrack showed live translated flows from node2/node3 post-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered connectivity via node1 NAT
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cce73776... matched pre-restart state; issued systemctl reboot; polled until reachable with new boot_id ebb4ca2f...; found route reverted to DHCP default (as expected, since it hadn't yet been persisted), re-applied persistent nmcli static route, and confirmed restored internet access plus conntrack NAT translation through node1.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered connectivity via node1 NAT
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d340bf4... (unchanged/healthy, and by this point node3 already had the persistent nmcli route applied); issued systemctl reboot; polled until reachable with new boot_id ae4c607b...; confirmed persistent default route survived reboot, internet access restored (curl 200, ping), and conntrack on node1 showed live NAT-translated flows for node3's IP.
